scripts.build: cargo build --workspace && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && pnpm --filter @ferrite/node build
scripts.build:example: pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- build --project examples/basic
scripts.dev:once: pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- dev --project examples/basic --once --request-path /posts/abc
scripts.lint: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime typecheck && pnpm --filter @ferrite/node typecheck
scripts.render:fixture: pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime build && node examples/basic/render.mjs | cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- render --input -
scripts.test: cargo test --workspace && pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime test && pnpm --filter @ferrite/node test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @ferrite/runtime typecheck && cargo run -p ferrite-cli -- check --project examples/basic
